notes: In the text they share, 2018_03 differs from 2018_04 only in 'Return to Section/Handbook Contents' navigation lines and the 11.9.1 title in the table of contents.

2018_02 (USM II-1.00) holds no parental provision: it defines tenure-track ranks (II.A.1) and the mandatory tenure-review year, which may change only 'unless otherwise agreed in writing'; it confirms the population covered by II-2.31.

Governing documents on 2018-03-13: USM II-2.25 (2018_01, identical in substance to handbook 11.9.1 in 2018_04) and the February 2018 handbook Section 11 (2018_04). The September 2015 copy (2018_03) carried UMBC's own 2002 Policy on Family and Medical Leave for Faculty as 11.9.1; the February 2018 copy replaces it with II-2.25. Provisions found only in 2018_03 (c12, c13, c14) are recorded with version_uncertain and an ambiguous superseded-copy flag; none affects a figure.

2018_05 is a January 2014 summary brochure; every provision it states (8 weeks, Family Support Plans, one-year tenure extension, collegial leave, FMLA, annual leave) is also in a governing document, so nothing is summary_only.

Chain, birth parent: paid parental leave up to 8 weeks (c1: accrued annual/sick/personal leave first, then institution-paid days), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c2) concurrent from the start; collegial sick leave (c8, discretionary, up to 25 workdays) then creditable sick leave (c9, own balance) pay incapacity, unlinked to c1.
Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave up to 8 weeks (c1, if primary caregiver; R6 treats the condition as gender-neutral), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c2) concurrent from the start.

No leave_limits entry: II-2.31 V deducts other F&M-related leave from the 12-workweek F&M entitlement, and II-2.25 III.B lists unpaid leave 'up to the twelve (12) week ... limit' of II-2.31; with c2 concurrent with c1 (S1) these do not cap any combination beyond FMLA's own 12 weeks.

II-2.31 sets F&M leave per calendar year and eligibility of 12 months plus 50% of full-time or 1,040 hours, broader than 29 U.S.C. 2611(2)'s 1,250 hours; coded as the policy states (statute length verified against statute text 2026_00_us_fmla_29usc2612).

Calendar: the documents speak of semesters ('during the semester in which parental leave is taken'; two semesters of employment) without stating a length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Not components: fellowship, sabbatical and librarian research leave, transitional terminal leave, accident leave (job injury), jury service, military leave and holidays (cannot be used for a birth); II-2.31 III.C leave to care for a school-age child during school vacations (not for a birth or adoption); II-2.25 V lactation space and VI anti-reprisal protection (no time off, pay, relief or job protection); II-2.30's reference to disability retirement or disability insurance (no plan terms stated).

Cross-references not saved: UMBC policies and procedures extending the time for tenure review (required by II-2.25 IV); BOR VII-7.45 Policy on Sick Leave (2018_03 only); 'USM's and the institution's existing leave procedures' (II-2.31 VI); UMBC and departmental workload policies (2018_03 only); USM Policy on Professional Commitment of Faculty; USM II-2.10 (terminal leave); Article 65 of the Annotated Code of Maryland; the Pregnancy Discrimination Act / Title VII text.
